free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes the RNG sequence so the run and its target hits are reproducible

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: terminates generation by node count (not wall clock) so the run is deterministic and fast

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: default wall-clock cap only; generation terminates on max_nodes before it applies

free_parameters.name: forward_prob
free_parameters.why: needs backward attempts to reach the guard plus forward successes so the rank-1 run can grow to max_nodes instead of spinning until the wall-clock timeout

free_parameters.name: limnf
free_parameters.why: memory/flops limiting is consulted after the target decision; disabling it keeps the guard the only shape-based skip

free_parameters.name: expand_last_dim
free_parameters.why: selects ExpandLast2, fixing the witness value op.expand_last_dim=2
